death.attack.tfcpp.asphyxiation: %1$s ran out of air to breathe
death.attack.tfcpp.blast: %1$s was caught in a gas explosion
death.attack.tfcpp.carbon_monoxide: %1$s fell asleep and never woke up
tfcpp.davy_lamp.blue_cap: A blue cap stands above the flame
tfcpp.davy_lamp.dim: The flame burns low and dull: the air is short of oxygen
tfcpp.davy_lamp.filled: Flame fills the whole gauze: the air is explosive, get out now
tfcpp.davy_lamp.out: The flame has died: this air cannot keep a flame going, and soon not a person either
tfcpp.davy_lamp.pale_cap: A faint pale cap shows above the flame
tfcpp.davy_lamp.steady: The flame burns steady and yellow
tfcpp.davy_lamp.tall_cap: A tall blue cap reaches up the gauze: get out soon
tfcpp.gas.smell.ammonia: A pungent smell of ammonia stings your eyes
tfcpp.gas.smell.chlorine: A sharp bleach-like smell burns your nose
tfcpp.gas.smell.hydrogen_sulfide: The air stinks of rotten eggs
tfcpp.gas.smell.sulfur_dioxide: A sharp, choking smell of burning sulfur catches your throat
tfcpp.info.coal: Coal seams hold methane, more of it the deeper they lie, and some rock next to them holds gas under pressure. Mining lets it out. A flame lights air holding 5% to 15% of it, and the blast is followed by afterdamp full of carbon monoxide.
tfcpp.info.davy_lamp: A lamp whose gauze keeps its flame from lighting the air around it. Carried in hand with oil in it, it shows firedamp as a blue cap above the flame, and goes out when oxygen runs low. It does not show carbon monoxide, and a gauze with gas burning in it for minutes gets hot enough to light the gas outside.
tfcpp.info.mine_fan: Driven by a shaft at its back, it blows out of its front and draws air in through its other sides, along the open spaces leading to it. Air moves quickly along a narrow drift and hardly at all across a large chamber. The fan loads the shaft more the faster it turns.
tfcpp.info.sentinel_cage: Right-click a rat or a quail with an empty cage. The animal takes in carbon monoxide twenty times as fast as a person, so it collapses long before you feel anything. Feed it grain from the other hand at least every three days.
tfcpp.info.settling_baffle: Place these in a closed chamber that furnace fumes pass through. Arsenic, antimony and zinc oxide dust settles on the plates, and is scraped off by right-clicking with an empty hand. Scraping stirs up some of the dust, so do not breathe it.
tfcpp.info.shaft_load: Every machine on a shaft takes torque from its source. The more it has to drive, the slower it turns, and past what the source can start against it stops. A water wheel gives its best power at half of its free speed. Pumps take more torque the higher they lift. Water itself no longer multiplies, and a pump moves it from its intake to its outlet.
tfcpp.retort.no_condenser: No condenser beside the retort: the vapour will escape into the room
tfcpp.sentinel.collapsed: The animal in the cage has collapsed: leave, the air is poisoned
tfcpp.sentinel.dead: The animal in the cage is dead
tfcpp.sentinel.starved: The animal in the cage has starved
tfcpp.sentinel.uneasy: The animal in the cage is uneasy and breathing fast
tfcpp.settling_baffle.nothing: Too little dust on the plates to scrape off
